items.meaning: 若中继代理决定中继该请求，它必须检查 'giaddr'（网关 IP 地址）字段。

items.condition: If the interface has more than one IP address logically associated with it

items.meaning: 若 'giaddr' 字段已含非零值，则不得修改该字段。
items.constraint: 非零 'giaddr' 不得被修改
items.object: 'giaddr' field
items.condition: If the 'giaddr' field contains some non-zero value

items.meaning: 中继代理在任何情况下都不得按 [1] 中的建议用广播地址填充 'giaddr' 字段。
items.constraint: 任何情况下都不得用广播地址填充 'giaddr'
items.object: 'giaddr' field with a broadcast address

items.meaning: 'hops' 字段的值必须被递增。
items.constraint: 'hops' 值必须递增

items.meaning: 所有其他 BOOTP 字段必须被完整保留。
items.constraint: 其他所有 BOOTP 字段必须保持不变
items.object: All other BOOTP fields

items.meaning: 中继请求被转发到的新目的地
items.constraint: MUST be configurable

items.constraint: SHOULD be independent of the destination configuration for any other so-called "broadcast forwarders"

items.meaning: 可能希望中继目的地为 IP 单播、组播、广播或其组合的管理者
转发 BOOTREQUEST 消息的中继代理
items.constraint: MUST NOT rebroadcast the BOOTREQUEST on the physical interface from whence it came

items.condition: if the BOOTREQUEST message was received as a broadcast

items.meaning: 转发 BOOTREQUEST 消息的中继代理

items.constraint: may assume that all BOOTREPLY messages it receives are intended for BOOTP clients on its directly-connected networks
items.object: all BOOTREPLY messages it receives are intended for BOOTP clients on its directly-connected networks

items.object: the BOOTP 'giaddr', 'yiaddr', 'chaddr', 'htype', and 'hlen' fields

items.meaning: 这些字段应提供足够信息供转发代理把 BOOTREPLY 消息投递给客户端
items.constraint: should provide adequate information for the relay agent to deliver the BOOTREPLY message to the client

items.condition: If this flag is set to 1

items.object: the reply
items.condition: If the BROADCAST flag is cleared (0)

items.meaning: 无法单播时可将回复以广播发送的情形
items.constraint: If unicasting is not possible, the reply MAY be sent as a broadcast
items.object: the reply
items.condition: If unicasting is not possible

items.meaning: 作为广播发送时应使用的链路层目的地址
items.constraint: in which case it SHOULD be sent to the link-layer broadcast address using the IP limited broadcast address 255.255.255.255
items.action: send to the link-layer broadcast address
items.object: the reply
items.condition: in which case

误设置 BROADCAST 标志的旧客户端或服务器实现应被改正以符合新规范

items.object: older client or server implementations which accidentally set the BROADCAST flag

items.meaning: 中继时必须保持完整不变的所有 BOOTP 字段
items.constraint: All BOOTP fields MUST be preserved intact.
items.object: All BOOTP fields

items.meaning: 中继向客户端转发 BOOTREPLY 时不得修改的字段

items.object: any BOOTP field of the BOOTREPLY message
items.condition: when relaying it to the client

items.object: BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器返回给客户端的回复报文。
items.constraint: 若 BOOTREPLY 带 UDP 校验和（非零），发送前必须重新计算校验和。
items.object: the checksum
items.condition: If the BOOTREPLY has a UDP checksum (i.e., the UDP checksum is non-zero)

items.action: accept for local delivery to the server
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages whose IP source address is 0.0.0.0
items.condition: hosts or routers which support a BOOTP server
items.normative_subject: hosts or routers which support a BOOTP server

items.meaning: BOOTP 客户端发出的请求报文。
items.constraint: 来自合法 IP 源地址的 BOOTREQUEST 消息也必须被接受。
items.object: BOOTREQUEST messages from legal IP source addresses
items.condition: BOOTREQUEST messages from legal IP source addresses

items.meaning: BOOTP 服务器必须静默丢弃目的端口为 BOOTPC（68）的 UDP 消息。
items.constraint: BOOTP 服务器必须静默丢弃目的 UDP 端口为 BOOTPC（68）的消息。
items.object: any received UDP messages whose UDP destination port number is BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: 说明性陈述：BOOTP 服务器应当没有处理发往 BOOTPC 端口消息的需要。
Consistency checks specified in Section 2.1 should be performed by the BOOTP server.
items.constraint: SHOULD be performed by the BOOTP server
items.object: consistency checks specified in Section 2.1

items.meaning: BOOTP messages that do not meet the consistency checks must be silently discarded.
items.constraint: MUST be silently discarded

items.object: value of the 'secs' field as a factor in deciding whether and/or how to reply
items.condition: When the BOOTP server receives a BOOTREQUEST message

items.constraint: SHOULD NOT be trusted as a sole key in identifying a client

items.constraint: BOOTREPLY SHOULD be sent as an IP unicast to the 'ciaddr' address

items.condition: If the 'ciaddr' field is non-zero

items.constraint: UDP destination port MUST be set to BOOTPC (68)
items.object: The UDP destination port to BOOTPC (68)

items.meaning: The server must be aware of the problems identified in Section 3.3.
items.constraint: server MUST be aware of the problems identified in Section 3.3
items.object: the problems identified in Section 3.3

items.condition: If this field is non-zero

items.constraint: UDP destination port MUST be set to BOOTPS (67)

items.meaning: The BOOTP relay agent closest to the client performs the final delivery of the BOOTREPLY message to the client.
The newly-defined BROADCAST flag, which the server may set to indicate that relay agents should broadcast the BOOTREPLY message to the client.

items.constraint: reply SHOULD be sent to the link-layer broadcast address using 255.255.255.255
items.object: to the link-layer broadcast address using the IP limited broadcast address 255.255.255.255 as the IP destination address
items.condition: If unicasting is not possible
